limitations: A later action is descriptive, not caused solely by this confirmation attempt.

Raw resources.falseReports combines missing stored-map proof with wrong names. truthWrongReports independently compares the actual emitted name to the post-choice assignment; missing stored-map entries are not false-report findings.
Attempt episodes may overlap; unique action counts remove episode duplication within each game.
No later report-consistent action is not a missed-opportunity finding; remaining activity/budget opportunities were not fully observed for this question.

Exact identity receipts and legitimate constraint deductions are separate. Raw memoryObservedAt/targetObserved track the stored perception known-map; derived singleton knowledge may be usable by the policy without appearing in that map. Do not treat an absent stored-map observation as forgetting. direct_known followup labels mean confirmed own knowledge, which may include valid deductions, not necessarily an exact identity receipt.

Raw counter incomingEligibleChoices is the pre-public-protection report-motivation gate; publiclyEligibleIncomingChoices independently applies diagnostic incoming-pool exclusions. Neither resource availability nor this pool proves the full policy reached its information stage.
